Could you advise if you have any flexibility to move the session earlier on Monday or push to Tuesday later and whether you can provide exec-level coverage if both Nebula execs cannot overlap?

- Option A (preferred for Nebula): Move to Monday 12/7 at 10:00 PT (60–75 min) — this works for their VP.
- Option B: Keep Tue but move to 16:30 PT to catch CTO, and we have A. Lewis join the late slot (they said maybe after 16:00 but uncertain).
- Option C: Keep Tue 15:00 PT but have Vivek join as backup exec (VP-level sponsor) if Nebula's VP can't make the later CTO window.

Please reply with availability. If Option A is possible, I will propose that to Tom and Priya and update the calendar.
